verdict.rationale: Swell offers a visual theme editor and a Shopify Online Store 2.0-compatible theme (Proxima) supporting sections and drag-and-drop customization, plus drag-and-drop category management, giving merchants a no-code path to storefront customization. However, evidence shows only one first-party theme rather than a broad library of 'professionally designed' themes, and the docs still emphasize Liquid/dev-facing theme creation. Missing for 10: a marketplace of multiple polished pre-built themes, clear merchant-facing UI screenshots/testimonials of no-code section editing, and independent hands-on confirmation of the theme editor's ease of use.
